_notes: High-fidelity couch profile for the tuned mpv engine (set-playback-engine.sh mpv-hifi).
Two ladders: main_ladder (smooth, grow/verify + Play priority) and last_resort_ladder (may stutter; Play fallback only).
Smoothness-first: prefer HW-smooth streams over marginal soft-decode 4K. 4K HEVC (Pi 5 HW) ranks above 1080p; soft 4K AV1/H.264 is last-resort.

exclude_hdr on the 4K steps drops HDR above 1080p: X11 cannot output HDR, so a 4K HDR frame would be GPU tone-mapped to SDR every frame and the Pi 5 cannot sustain that at 4K (heavy stutter). HDR titles fall through to 1080p or last_resort at play time.
Display (GET /stream) expands main_ladder only; if empty, shows last_resort_ladder marked unverified.
Play auto: main then last_resort (+ obligation floor). Grow/verify: main only. Picker click: single stream, no fallthrough.
Last-resort Play success marks title stale (playback-only) — never refreshes verified.
REMUX is confined to the 4K steps; 1080p stays on efficient encodes to avoid high-bitrate AVC software-decode load.
Cached-only on main (include_uncached=false); uncached TorBox lives on last_resort only.
